Phone No: 8971498495 Email ID: Kiran.raj9.r@gmail.com www.linkedin.com/in/kiranrajr

Experienced Senior Business Execution Consultant (SAVP) with 8+ years of expertise in leading large-scale change and transformation initiatives. Skilled in developing end-to-end change strategies, designing detailed implementation plans, conducting impact and readiness assessments, and building strong business readiness plans. Adept in creating communication and training programs that enable adoption and minimize resistance. Known for effective stakeholder management, strong teamwork, and a positive approach while ensuring smooth execution, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. Committed to leveraging consulting and change management expertise to be a valuable asset to any organization.

Education

Profile Summary

2015: BE – Electrical and Electronic Engineering from MVJ college of Engineering

Core Competencies

Business Process Modeling and Notation

Process Documentation and Analysis

Data Analysis and Process mining

Pre Sales of SAP Products & Solution Implementation

Business Process & Operational Excellence: With 8 years of experience analyzing complex business processes, I excel at identifying improvement opportunities and implementing data- driven solutions to enhance operational efficiency. I conduct thorough requirements gathering and facilitate cross-functional communication to align teams with strategic goals. Process Documentation & Analysis: Skilled in business process documentation and analysis using BPMN tools such as iGrafx, IBM Blue Works Live, BizzDesign, Signavio, and Aris. I create effective process models, document workflows, and analyze processes to pinpoint inefficiencies and ensure alignment with organizational objectives. Organizational Change Management (OCM): Proven track record of leading end-to-end change initiatives, including strategy, impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, and adoption management, to deliver measurable business outcomes. Skilled in conducting targeted stakeholder interviews, designing communication and training plans, and providing actionable insights that guide decision-making and reinforce sustainable change. Experienced in driving stakeholder alignment, mitigating resistance, and enabling adoption across cross-functional teams Led high-impact change initiatives within GBS and functional leaders by developing and executing comprehensive change strategies, conducting impact and readiness assessments, and driving stakeholder engagement. Designed and implemented targeted communication, training, and Go- Live plans, tracking adoption to manage resistance and ensure long-term sustainability. Operational Improvement & Performance: Focused on process re-engineering to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and achieve sustainable performance improvements. Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth transitions and high project success rates.

Change Management

Process Re-engineering

Work Experience

Senior Business Execution Consultant | Wells Fargo | March 2025 – Till date

Led enterprise change initiatives by applying structured OCM methodologies, performing change-impact assessments, and delivering targeted change strategies to drive successful adoption for major Wells Fargo projects including DIB, the Virtual Assistant Chatbot, and PED initiatives. Performed comprehensive current-state and future-state mapping in Signavio and ARIS for key Wells Fargo initiatives such as DIB, the Virtual Assistant Chatbot, and PED, capturing detailed process flows, dependencies, and pain points to drive gap analysis, impact assessment, readiness planning, and end-to-end change implementation. Leveraged enterprise OCM methodologies to analyse the degree of organizational change, evaluate impact levels across teams, and design tailored change interventions—including communication plans, training strategies, and support structures—to drive smooth transitions and successful adoption. Partnered with cross-functional teams on DIB, conducting shadowing sessions, coordinating with stakeholders, and supporting readiness activities to ensure seamless implementation and delivery. Led the development of change management strategies by proactively tracking departmental change activities, assessing stakeholder impacts and cross-program dependencies, and engaging early in design and solution discussions to shape business impacts and ensure seamless alignment across the change lifecycle.

Business Consultant | Tech Mahindra | July’22 – March 2025 | Client – Telstra , 3UK , Edge Group

Clients Handled

Provide expert consulting in end-to-end messaging product design for clients, covering key strategies like O2A (Order to Activate), Usage to Cash, R2R (Record to Report), and Billings process. Conduct detailed market research to identify and resolve potential issues, ensuring a smooth and successful product launch without roadblocks or bottlenecks.

Led enterprise-wide change initiatives by conducting in-depth gap analyses, stakeholder impact assessments, and readiness planning, resulting in a 80% improvement in adoption rates and seamless implementation of strategic programs across cross-functional teams.

Specialized in drafting comprehensive End-to-End process models for Enterprise Business using SAP Signavio, Aris, BizzDesign & IBM Blue works Live. My role involves identifying business opportunities, crafting and presenting solutions to stakeholders, and managing projects with tight deadlines through JIRA. I oversee team utilization, conduct internal reviews and risk assessments, and work to enhance process efficiency. Additionally, I leverage project management skills to develop schedules and deliver tailored consulting solutions for Telecom clients, leading a team of Process Improvement Analysts to ensure successful outcomes.

Designed and executed holistic change management strategies by leveraging enterprise methodologies, partnering with senior leadership (including C-suite), driving stakeholder engagement and communication plans, conducting key assessments (impact, readiness, stakeholder), and enabling adoption of new ways of working across large-scale transformation programs.

Served as a key Business Process Management SME by translating process requirements into future-state process definitions and workflows using SAP Signavio & Aris, ensuring harmonized process taxonomy across global and local functions; collaborated with ERP, applications, and domain experts to build an aligned process structure, support BPM governance, and strengthen the organization’s future vision for Signavio-driven operational quality and process governance.

Process Engineer| Wells Fargo | Dec 2020 – July 2022 |

Led a comprehensive gap analysis and requirements gathering initiative to identify operational inefficiencies. By systematically assessing current processes and comparing them with industry best practices, I pinpointed areas for improvement. This strategic evaluation facilitated the development of targeted solutions to optimize operational efficiency and streamline workflows. Utilized BPMN tools – IGRAFX, ARIS, and SAP SIGNAVIO for detailed process mapping, ensuring adherence to standards. Integrated Quality Centre and JIRA for rigorous oversight, ensuring accurate and compliant process documentation. Experienced in designing business processes and proposing improvements to configuration standards. Skilled in optimizing workflows and ensuring compliance with best practices to enhance efficiency and performance. Conduct masterclass training for stakeholders to deepen their understanding and application of business Process Modelling concepts, enhancing their effectiveness and knowledge.

Business Analyst | IBM | Jan 2020 – Dec 2020 | Client – Telstra

Led the integration of ServiceNow with ITSM tools, including IT Asset Management (ITAM), to streamline asset tracking and enhance overall IT service management processes. Analysed diverse data sources to derive business insights through statistical analysis and validation, ensuring alignment with client and project needs. Managed incoming service issues with effective problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), and RACI to maintain operational efficiency. Created monthly SLA reports for IBM’s senior client and leadership, highlighting target achievements, and led project discussions with automation engineers and Splunk architects for continuous improvement.

Previous Work Experience

Senior Associate | DXC Technology | July 2017 – Dec 2019 | Client – AT&T & Shell
